lines.zh: 缓慢移动，发出沉重的脚步声。
lines.en: Move slowly, making heavy footsteps.
Drag its rotting body.
Lick the rotting flesh, making a hissing sound.
Stare at you, slowly advancing.
Grasp at you with rotting fingers.
Scream with a dry voice.

lines.zh: 我边走边咬空气，牙齿咯咯响。
lines.en: I bite the air as I walk, teeth clicking.
One leg drags behind and still I walk.

lines.zh: 地上的烂肉，也够我嚼半天。
lines.en: This rotten meat on the ground will keep me chewing.

lines.zh: 一条腿拖在后面，磨出声音
lines.en: One leg drags behind, scraping loudly.

lines.zh: 它扶着断墙，慢慢挪过去
lines.en: It leans on a broken wall and shuffles past.

lines.zh: 喉咙干得发不出完整的声
lines.en: Its throat is too dry for a whole sound.
Stare at you for a long time.
Slowly chew the rotting flesh.
Turn over the nearby rotting stuff.
Scan the surroundings.

lines.zh: 保持警惕，缓缓转动头部。
lines.en: Stay alert, slowly turn its head.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙漏气，嘶嘶响个不停。
lines.en: Air leaks from my throat in a endless hiss.
Search for new food sources.

lines.zh: 我抽动了一下，又定在原地。
lines.en: I twitch once, then freeze in place again.
Stay still and observe.
Chomp on the nearby rotting matter.
Stare at you for a moment.
Quickly turn to you.
Stare at you with empty eyes.
Stare at you with vacant eyes.
Look at you, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，口水拉成一条线。
lines.en: My mouth hangs open, drool trailing in a line.
noticed you.
Turn to look at you.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝里没有光，只有黑。
lines.en: There is no light in my eye sockets, only black.
I slowly turn my face, only my face.
Decaying flesh trembles.
My bones crack like dry branches.
Rotting muscles rip apart.
I feel weak.

lines.zh: 我的肚子裂开，肠子拖在身后。
lines.en: My belly splits open, and my guts trail behind me.
I'm injured, the pain is unbearable.

lines.zh: 一条腿断了，我还在往前。
lines.en: One leg is broken; I still push forward.
Putrefying flesh.

lines.zh: 这一下让我半边身子歪了。
lines.en: That knocked half my body crooked.
Rotting everywhere.

lines.zh: 你吃我的肉，我还你骨头！
lines.en: You eat my flesh, I give you bones.

lines.zh: 靠近我，你就会明白痛苦！
lines.en: Come close, you'll feel the pain.

lines.zh: 饥饿的行尸，渴望你的鲜血！
lines.en: Hunger drives me, craving your blood.

lines.zh: 你手里那块面包，比石头还香。
lines.en: That bread in your hand smells sweeter than stone.

lines.zh: 你不知道，我比你想象的更接近！
lines.en: You don't know how close I am.

lines.zh: 我的手指会把你的肉撕裂！
lines.en: My fingers will rip your flesh.

lines.zh: 饥饿，我唯一的念头就是吞噬！
lines.en: Hunger, my only thought is to consume.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉，行尸的耐心有限！
lines.en: You can't escape, my patience is limited.

lines.zh: 你闻到了吗？我腐烂的气息！
lines.en: Do you smell it? My rotten stench.

lines.zh: 有活人的味道，就在附近
lines.en: There is living blood nearby.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你会尝到死亡的味道！
lines.en: Collide with me, you'll taste death.
Here come the Walkers, nowhere to run.
My guts are hanging out in the open.
My limbs will trap you.

lines.zh: 别想躲开，行尸的力量强大！
lines.en: Don't try to avoid me, Walker strength is great.

lines.zh: 行尸不会饶恕任何干扰！
lines.en: Walkers don't forgive interruptions.

lines.zh: 小心我的爪子，它们会撕裂你！
lines.en: Watch out for my claws, they rip flesh.
Walker's impact, no escape.
Be hit by me, you'll regret it.
Walker power, not to be underestimated.

lines.zh: 做我的同伴吧，一起啃这条路。
lines.en: Be my mate; let us chew this road together.
We Walkers need flesh!

lines.zh: 你的伴侣就是我的猎物！
lines.en: Your partner is my prey.
We share a goal.

lines.zh: 与我在一起，你不再孤单！
lines.en: Stay with me, you're not alone.
The Walker tribe needs you.

lines.zh: 你的生命即将结束，开始！
lines.en: Your life ends, it begins.

lines.zh: 与我一起，你将得到新生！
lines.en: With me, you'll find rebirth.

lines.zh: 成为我的同伴，你将获得力量！
lines.en: Be my companion, you'll gain strength.
With me, you'll live forever.

lines.zh: 我在垃圾堆里翻出一块发霉的肉。
lines.en: I dig a moldy piece of meat out of the trash.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，啃那具尸体剩下的部分。
lines.en: I crouch and gnaw what is left of the corpse.
Chomp its flesh.
This flesh is delicious.
I will consume all.
Food in my sight.

lines.zh: 我跪下，去舔地上那摊黑血。
lines.en: I kneel and lick the black blood off the floor.
My stomach growls.
This scrap of meat goes in my pocket.
Hunger drives me.
Prey in my sight.
It's close now.
I see its weakness.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子抽动，认准了你的位置。
lines.en: My nose twitches; I have your position.
Target there.
End it.
It is just past that broken wall.
Its blood is sweet.
I will feast.
Its presence excites me.
It turns its head, mouth opening first.

lines.zh: 尸群里的它先盯上了你
lines.en: Among the horde, this one spots you first.
It reaches out both hands and comes for you.

lines.zh: 它扑在门上，抓出几道痕
lines.en: It throws itself at the door, clawing marks.
It smells the blood from your wound.
It will taste my teeth.
I will tear its throat.
I will chomp its head.
It won't get a second chance.
I will enjoy this fight.

lines.zh: 我不会让任何生物活下来。
lines.en: No biomes shall live.

lines.zh: 我会用我的爪子撕碎它。
lines.en: I will shred it with my claws.
I will kill it.
I will end its life.
I will bite it with my teeth.

lines.zh: 它不喊不叫，只是一直走
lines.en: It makes no sound; it just keeps walking.

lines.zh: 脚步一深一浅，越来越近
lines.en: Its uneven steps grow nearer.
It circles the house, hunting an entrance.

lines.zh: 它把脸贴在窗上往里看
lines.en: It presses its face to the window.

lines.zh: 被推开，它又慢慢站起来
lines.en: Pushed down, it slowly rises again.
It stares at your throat.
The horde gathers behind it.
It does not lunge; it just presses forward.
One bite and the blood comes out.

lines.zh: 我咬偏了，牙磕在你的护肩上。
lines.en: I bite wide, teeth cracking on your pauldron.
Not sweet enough!
Pain, human!

lines.zh: 我的手抓住你的衣领了。
lines.en: My hand has your collar.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的手背，怎么甩都不松。
lines.en: I clamp onto your hand and will not let go.
One bite and you walk with us.

lines.zh: 我嘴里嚼着腐肉，朝你伸出手。
lines.en: Chewing rotten meat, I reach a hand toward you.
Enjoy the pain!
You will become me!
It locks its teeth on your arm.

lines.zh: 腐牙撕开皮肉，血流出来
lines.en: Rotting teeth tear skin and blood runs.
It pins you to the wall and gnaws.
Its nails dig into your shoulder.

lines.zh: 一口咬在小腿上，甩不掉
lines.en: It bites your calf and will not be shaken off.

lines.zh: 伤口开始发黑，止不住血
lines.en: The wound darkens and will not stop bleeding.

lines.zh: 墙后传来第二声低吼，我回应它。
lines.en: A second growl sounds behind the wall, and I answer.
New soul, new walker!
Curse of the end!
Wander in the dark!

lines.zh: 我从塌掉的墙里爬出来，尘土满身。
lines.en: I crawl from a collapsed wall, coated in dust.
Hunger's walker horde!
Walkers in the dark!
Whispers of the end!
Decaying walker horde!

lines.zh: 地里的腐肉把我叫了起来。
lines.en: Rotten meat in the soil called me up.

lines.zh: 废墟的阴影里站起一个
lines.en: One rises in the shadow of the ruins.

lines.zh: 远处传来拖行的脚步声
lines.en: A dragging gait sounds in the distance.

lines.zh: 它从翻倒的车后走出来
lines.en: It comes out from behind an overturned cart.

lines.zh: 门窗一响，它们都转过来
lines.en: A door creaks and they all turn.

lines.zh: 我的袖子着了，皮肉滋滋作响。
lines.en: My sleeve catches, and my flesh sizzles.
I fell and got hurt.

lines.zh: 泥水灌进我的喉咙，我还在爬。
lines.en: Mud fills my throat, and I keep crawling.

lines.zh: 火光里，我的半边身子飞了出去。
lines.en: In the firelight, half my body flies away.
There is a hole in my chest and I still walk.
Spell burns my skin.

lines.zh: 饿了太久，连腐肉都变香了。
lines.en: Hungry so long that rot smells good.
I'm already charred, and it strikes me.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地面，我连叫都叫不出。
lines.en: No ground below me; I cannot even scream.
